tasks.title: Reconcile graph checkpoint onto current verified Cortex source
tasks.description: Start from the latest verified hero-editions branch, not the old 43ceccb graph base. Import only graph paths, retain original history and keep runtime integration off until accepted. Confirm active ownership and native release version.
acceptance: Current production UI, required Male/Female control, backup and xAI service are preserved.
Graph checkpoint is present on a new named branch with clean ownership.
Existing regression baseline and nine prototype tests are recorded without calling them scientific validation.
tasks.nativeAcceptance: Current production UI, required Male/Female control, encrypted backup and xAI service are preserved. Graph checkpoint aae0e60 is imported into a new branch with clean ownership. Baseline regression and prototype tests are recorded separately from scientific validation.

tasks.title: Build claim-level source, cohort and measurement provenance
tasks.description: Review primary studies and relevant frameworks. Record actual task, population, outcome, estimate/uncertainty when available, nulls, corrections, read depth and cohort overlap. Separate component evidence, joint-effect evidence and editorial hypothesis. No numeric weights from publication type alone.
acceptance: Every imported empirical claim has a result-specific locator and scope.
Null, conflicting and overlapping-cohort evidence is retained.
Unsupported/uncertain records are quarantined or explicitly labeled rather than upgraded.
tasks.nativeAcceptance: Every imported empirical claim resolves to a result-specific source and scope. Null and contrary findings and overlapping cohorts are retained. Unsupported records remain explicitly unknown rather than being promoted by source count.

tasks.title: Reconcile functional ontology and typed graph edges
tasks.description: Resolve the partial unused process file and inconsistent domain mapping. Introduce stable IDs and deliberate process-to-system links. Distinguish measured association, task mapping, hypothetical interaction, context and narrative edges. Do not infer a joint mechanism from a shared citation.
acceptance: All node and claim references resolve with explicit edge semantics.
ID stability, duplicate claims/cohorts and missing data are tested.
Distinct threat/safety, working-context and social processes are not accidentally collapsed by a generic UI-domain mapping.
tasks.nativeAcceptance: All nodes and claims resolve with typed edge semantics. Stable IDs, duplicate/cohort checks and missing-data tests pass. Threat/safety and working-context processes are not accidentally collapsed by generic domain mapping.

tasks.title: Replace uncalibrated confidence scoring with an auditable evidence contract
tasks.description: Current weights and thresholds are editorial constants, not learned or calibrated. Separate reported fit, counterexample coverage, source directness/consistency, joint-effect evidence and individual measurement. Define a valid estimand/data protocol before any probability or effect-size claim.
acceptance: No current supportIndex is represented as a probability, biomarker or measured certainty.
Tests do not require arbitrary high scores for a favored hero.
Perturbing unknown/counterexample/source-quality inputs has documented bounded behavior.
tasks.nativeAcceptance: Support indices are not represented as probabilities, biomarkers or measured certainty. Remove arbitrary high-score acceptance targets. Document bounded, testable effects of missing answers, counterexamples and evidence quality.

tasks.title: Implement bounded compositional inference and explanations
tasks.description: Evaluate eligible compositions with the accepted evidence contract. Preserve preferred eligible signatures, explicit counterexamples and unknowns. Bound pair/hyperedge traversal; counts of possible combinations are not numbers of validated relationships. Keep observed friction separate from proposed trade-offs.
acceptance: Deterministic output, malformed inputs, source withdrawal and counterfactual response changes are tested.
No path manufactures anatomy or ability from age, sex, gender or history.
Each personal conclusion resolves to input observations; each research claim resolves to accepted evidence.
tasks.nativeAcceptance: Determinism, malformed inputs, source withdrawal and changed/counterexample responses are tested. No anatomy or ability is manufactured from demographics or history. Every personal conclusion resolves to observations and every research claim to accepted evidence.

tasks.title: Integrate accessible evidence graph and scientific report adapter
tasks.description: Expose paths from observation to process to claim and source, with measured/hypothesized edges and accessible text. Preserve current short hero style, privacy appendices, stable hero/portrait IDs, device saves and encrypted backups. No private graph details go to image/design providers.
acceptance: Desktop, 320/390/768 mobile and WebKit navigation are usable.
A4/Letter scientific explanation and hero PDFs are visually inspected.
Existing accepted image bytes, saved profiles and backup roundtrips remain valid; no automatic paid request.
tasks.nativeAcceptance: Desktop, narrow mobile and WebKit flows work. A4/Letter reports are visually inspected. Existing saved profiles, encrypted backup roundtrips and accepted image bytes remain compatible, with no automatic paid requests.

tasks.title: Independent review, complete regression and exact-artifact publication
tasks.description: Independently challenge representative evidence paths and misleading score/wording risks. Run affected full tests, keep failed receipts, verify an immutable artifact, re-read native production, preserve rollback, deploy only accepted output and verify public hashes and user flow.
acceptance: Research review and software checks are distinguished.
Current source/commit, build hashes, provider version, rollback and live checks are recorded.
No capability is called clinically validated or calibrated without actual proof.
tasks.nativeAcceptance: Independent research review and software acceptance are documented separately. Source/build hashes, native deployment, rollback and public checks are recorded. No validation or calibration is claimed without actual evidence.

tasks.title: Design optional public account and portrait entitlement rollout
tasks.description: The current xAI studio is a private-pass pilot. Assess real signup/account recovery, private access, lifecycle, quotas and costs before replacing it. An account does not by itself make questionnaire data confidential or end-to-end encrypted. Keep anonymous reflection and local backups functional.
acceptance: Concrete identity, deletion, recovery and provider/data-transfer boundaries reviewed.
Separate user authorization and rollout acceptance before activating paid/public endpoints.
tasks.nativeAcceptance: Identity, account recovery, deletion, provider processing and privacy boundaries are reviewed. Public paid rollout has its own authorization and operational acceptance. Existing local reflection and backups remain usable.

tasks.title: Design consented longitudinal usefulness and calibration study
tasks.description: Specify research questions, outcomes, counterexamples, repeatability, sampling, privacy, withdrawal and separate opt-in consent. Do not silently reuse private reflections or claim a completed meta-analysis from the registry.
acceptance: A prespecified study/evaluation protocol is reviewed before data collection.
Product enjoyment, self-recognition, performance and neural measurement remain distinct outcomes.
tasks.nativeAcceptance: A prespecified research protocol, consent and data-handling plan is reviewed before collection. Enjoyment, self-recognition, performance and neural measurement remain distinct outcomes.
